original_test_intent: With the approved amdgpu driver state established, verify complete Redfish chassis health for the UBB and every OAM0-7, requiring each object's Health and HealthRollup to be OK and State to be Enabled.
original_method: Capture SUT/BMC/GPU/driver and current binding state, approve/load amdgpu only if necessary and safe, discover/validate exact UBB plus eight OAM resource identities, query each through protected Redfish with complete HTTP/JSON evidence, normalize the three required status fields per object and correlate any failure to host/BMC/GPU/thermal logs without clearing or mutating state.
manual_activity: The owner approves endpoint/schema/chassis map and amdgpu state transition; an operator confirms workload quiescence and watches GPU health; the owner reviews all nine objects and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Actual protected VNIC Redfish endpoint/schema and TLS/auth policy
Exact UBB and eight OAM resource IDs mapped to physical modules
Health/HealthRollup/State field semantics and freshness/caching rules
Approval and recovery path for loading the driver if absent
safety_requirements: Use protected credentials and TLS/hostname validation
Do not assume 192.168.31.1 or resource names without mapping
Load amdgpu only after approval and only if absent/required
Do not unload, rebind or reset GPUs to force State=Enabled
Require complete successful JSON for exactly nine objects
Stop on driver/GPU/service error, missing/duplicate/stale object or any non-OK/Enabled status
No automatic module-load or query retry that obscures state
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only identities, current driver/binding and chassis map
Prepare protected per-object queries and validate schema
Load amdgpu only after explicit approval, then collect all nine complete responses
Normalize and report each required field and correlated health evidence
Perform no endpoint/map/health-policy invention, unload/rebind/reset, recovery decision or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve endpoint/schema, nine-object map and status semantics
Approve driver-load necessity, workload quiescence and recovery
Disposition any non-OK/missing/stale object and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The loop names the correct source objects but uses insecure access, assumes fixed identities and does not verify modprobe impact or per-request HTTP/JSON completeness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After driver-state approval, use a protected session to query exact mapped UBB and OAM0-7 resources independently, retaining full JSON, HTTP outcome, identity and timestamp for each.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: modprobe amdgpu, UBB and OAM0-7 resources, Health/HealthRollup/State criteria, no bundle and 10/10-minute values remain; examples require secure live mapping.

modernized_recommendation.status: HYBRID PACKAGE-GATED UBB/OAM CHASSIS HEALTH MATRIX
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a nine-row physical-resource matrix tied to an approved driver state and protected Redfish snapshots with field-level validation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, security, driver-state and completeness controls without changing any required object or field.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful shell loop or one aggregate response can conceal failed HTTP requests, missing OAMs or stale/incorrect resources.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Driver load can change ownership/services, and Redfish state may be cached; pre/post binding and freshness evidence are required.

project_override_considerations: If fitted OAM count or resource names differ, the owner must approve the physical inventory and expected absent-state behavior. Source coverage of eight OAMs cannot be silently reduced.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and DeepSeek access/completeness defect record
Endpoint/schema/auth, SUT/BMC/UBB/OAM/GPU/driver identities and physical chassis map
Pre/post amdgpu module/binding/service evidence and approval
Complete independent UBB and OAM0-7 HTTP/JSON responses with identity/timestamp
Nine-row Health=OK, HealthRollup=OK, State=Enabled comparison plus missing/duplicate/stale audit
No-clear/no-secret/no-reset/no-retry audit, correlated logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source hard-codes insecure HTTP/-k examples and UBB/OAM names without endpoint/schema/identity/freshness or driver-impact rules and asks to clear logs. DeepSeek inherits fixed/insecure assumptions and omits request-completeness checks.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; endpoint/schema/map, compatible driver, approval and recovery are supplyable inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2052 Wistron-AMD SVM-01063-V003: approve the actual protected Redfish endpoint/schema, physical UBB plus OAM0-7 resource map and freshness rules, exact Health/HealthRollup/State semantics including expected absent behavior, and whether/when modprobe amdgpu is required with workload, service and recovery controls.

review_improvement: Preserves all nine object/field checks, makes driver loading an explicit gated state change, and replaces insecure loop success with identity-bound per-request evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A loop can exit after mixed successes and failures unless every response is validated independently; therefore nine complete identity-bound JSON results are required. HealthRollup is not interchangeable with component Health, and State=Enabled is conditional on the expected driver/binding state. Loading amdgpu may claim devices or affect services, so it is not a passive prerequisite and needs approval and recovery evidence.
